name: Alex Chen
title: Security Researcher & Full Stack Developer
shortBio: Passionate cybersecurity professional and software developer with over 8 years of experience in penetration testing, vulnerability research, and secure application development.
longBio: Passionate cybersecurity professional and software developer with over 8 years of experience in penetration testing, vulnerability research, and secure application development. I specialize in web application security, network security, and secure coding practices. My research focuses on discovering novel attack vectors and developing defensive strategies against emerging threats. I'm an active contributor to the security community through open-source projects, conference presentations, and technical publications. When I'm not hunting for vulnerabilities or writing code, I enjoy participating in CTF competitions and mentoring aspiring security professionals.
